IP Source Group Resource Delete Source IP Group
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipSourceGroups/:ipGroupId

Deletes the IP source group for the specified ID.

Note: Only user-defined IP groups can be deleted.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ipGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the IP source group.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
